stations.title: Dilys
stations.note: And the key goes for good.

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Anyone with the key can delete anything.

stations.title: Your guards
stations.gap: Nobody checks who may do what

captions: Dilys wants the shared key gone, and only her to remove a workshop.
Today anyone with the key can change or delete anything, and nobody knows who did.
You write a sign-in guard, a role guard, and a staff list only the owner can see.
Now Kofi's delete of the glazing class is refused, while his changes still go through.
Reads stay open, changes come from named people, and each role does only its part.
